info.description: API for Markdown notes stored as YAML files and searched through a SQLite index.

get.description: Tell whether the assistant can answer questions, so that a UI can say so before a question is asked.

get.description: Tell how the server authenticates people and whether the request is signed in.

post.description: Begin signing in a client without a browser, such as the TUI. The client shows the user code and the URL, people approve the code in the web UI, signed in with a passkey, and the client gets a session from device_token meanwhile.

Files added within the last hour are marked recent, as the note may still be being edited.

post.description: Sync the notes with their git repository: commit the changes of the notes directory, then, when the branch has an upstream branch, fetch it, merge it and push. A merge never stops in conflict: a note changed on both sides keeps this side's version, and the other side's version becomes a new note in the same notebook, with the conflict in its title; another file keeps this side's version; a file deleted on one side and changed on the other keeps the changed version. The index is updated afterwards. For people only.

post.description: Create a notebook from its display name. The ID, which is also the directory name, is derived from the name with only the characters an ID allows: an ASCII name is lower-cased with dashes ("My Notes" gives my-notes), and any other name is Punycode-encoded as in internationalized domain names, giving an ID that starts with xn--. A suffix such as -2 is added when the ID is taken.
